mandatory_rules.title: Manufacturer / Packer Identity
mandatory_rules.description: Name of the manufacturer or packer or importer must be clearly declared on the principal display panel.

mandatory_rules.title: Complete Manufacturer Address
mandatory_rules.description: Complete postal address of the manufacturer/packer/importer must be displayed.

mandatory_rules.title: Generic or Common Name
mandatory_rules.description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared.

mandatory_rules.title: Net Quantity Declaration
mandatory_rules.description: Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, L) or number must be stated.

mandatory_rules.title: Date of Manufacture / Packaging
mandatory_rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed must be clearly mentioned.

mandatory_rules.title: Best Before / Expiry Date
mandatory_rules.description: Best before or use by date must be declared on commodities having limited shelf life.

mandatory_rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
mandatory_rules.description: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) in INR inclusive of all taxes must be declared without overwriting or manipulation.

mandatory_rules.title: Consumer Care Details
mandatory_rules.description: Name, address, telephone number and email address of the person/office to contact for consumer grievances.

mandatory_rules.title: FSSAI License / Registration
mandatory_rules.description: 14-digit FSSAI license number must be printed on all food and dietary commodities.
